metrics.threshold_sweep_type: event positive cutoff; negative cutoff fixed, scores between cutoffs route to review

latency.p95_method: nearest-rank; descriptive only; small-sample estimates are unstable

metrics.note: Pilot corpus metrics only; synthetic and small. Threshold sweep is descriptive and must not be treated as production calibration.

interpretation.evidence_route: hold candidates only when candidates exist and insufficient-evidence score is at or above the threshold
interpretation.unlisted_route: create a separate review task at or above the threshold without blocking known-event candidates
interpretation.choice_route: save topic and confidence; no Choice review gate in this flow
interpretation.event_abstain_route: retain score state for inspection; abstain alone does not create a review task

note: Synthetic-only exploratory pilot. Responses are sanitized; annotations are single-curator draft labels, not human-adjudicated gold. No automatic retries or model fallback. The cost stop uses a per-call estimate; one call can exceed the threshold before its returned usage is known.
